ns2:course.label: Strategies of Clin Intrvention
ns2:course.description: (PSYCH 445) Critical survey of issues, principles, practice, and research related to modifying human behavior; covers psychotherapeutic and somatic approaches; symptomatic relief and personality-restructuring; goal-orientations; and individual family, group, milieu, and preventive community intervention. Prerequisite: Concurrent registration in PSYC 547 strongly recommended.
